raw_text: ☀️🌸🌿 Good morning, Oleg. It is a privilege to guide you through this Sunday, October 25, 2026. Your natal chart is defined by an Ascendant in Aquarius (1°32') and a Sun in Gemini, with your Midheaven (MC) positioned in Scorpio (28°46'); today, the transit of the Moon through Aries activates your 3rd house of communication and local mobility, while the Sun as the ruler of the day illuminates your 7th house of partnerships, setting a high-energy tone for your Sunday. 🪐 Planetary influence today The transit of the Moon in Aries brings a sharp, impulsive edge to your intellectual processes, encouraging you to speak your mind with conviction. With the Sun governing the day and aspecting your 7th house, the focus shifts toward assertive leadership in your interpersonal interactions, requiring you to balance your Aquarius-driven need for independence with the necessity of collaborative success. 💼 Работа, бизнес и финансы This Sunday is an excellent window for strategic planning and reviewing complex financial audits, as your mental acuity is heightened by the Moon-Sun interplay. For high-stakes negotiations or critical business calls, prioritize the window from 10:15 to 12:30, as this timing aligns with the peak of your solar energy for the day. Avoid finalizing binding contracts during the afternoon slump between 15:00 and 16:45, as the Aries energy may prompt you to overlook minor, yet significant, contractual details. ❤️ Личные отношения и общение Your communication style today will be direct and potentially confrontational, which may surprise those accustomed to your usual Gemini-Aquarius intellectual detachment. Use this honesty to clear the air in long-standing business or personal disputes, but remain mindful that your partners may need time to process your bold approach. Focus on listening as much as you speak to ensure that your message is not just heard, but fully understood. 🌿 Здоровье и тонус Your physical vitality is high, but the intense Aries energy of the Moon can lead to nervous tension or minor headaches if you do not pace yourself. To maintain your equilibrium, incorporate a brief, high-intensity workout in the morning to burn off excess adrenaline, and ensure you practice grounding meditation in the evening to soothe your nervous system. 💡 Добрый совет на сегодня Because the Moon in Aries can trigger a tendency toward impatience or irritability, your compensatory strategy is to practice the art of the pause. Before reacting to a challenging piece of information, take three deep, conscious breaths; this small act of physical grounding will prevent unnecessary friction in your professional and personal life, allowing you to maintain control over your environment. ✨ Пожелание на сегодня May the clarity of the morning sun illuminate your path, granting you the wisdom to turn every challenge into a stepping stone toward your greater goals. Walk with the confidence of a leader, knowing that your potential is vast and your capacity for success is as boundless as the sky.
